baseline.authorization: existing account_access and owner/admin; no new secondary password

contract.read: typed raw nullable URL and updated_at; save capability separate from employee list
contract.save: only canonical TestFlight URL; expected raw before URL null/empty distinct plus updated_at CAS; capture bearer; atomic receipt and update
contract.receipt: same op and same payload returns original result; differing payload denied; new login may lookup with current actor/company/rights, never resubmit old operation
contract.unknown: persist secret-free operation identity and fingerprint; block resend; result query only; missing result stays unresolved
contract.lifecycle: reuse permanent retirement from tracking unavailable/error/done/SID ABA; do not fall back to legacy LIMIT 1 RPC

new_tables: private append-only operation receipt without FK to existing company/auth tables
review_requirements: exact dependency definitions/owners/ACL pinned before real install

no existing company fields other than employee_testflight_url and updated_at changed
raw invalid before value retained for CAS, never normalized/erased
new API absent/OFF/unknown authorization disables only URL save
existing create invite and company link secondary authentication unchanged
separate_unimplemented: server invite preflight before account creation
